title: Gabriel-Type Estimates for Harmonic Quasiregular Mappings and Stoilow Classes
summary: We establish a dilatation-dependent Gabriel inequality for sense-preserving harmonic $K$-quasiregular mappings in $h^2$. If $f=h+\overline g\in h^2$ satisfies $|g'|\le k|h'|$, where $K=(1+k)/(1-k)$, then every convex curve $Γ\subset\D$ satisfies \[ \int_Γ|f(z)|^2\ds(z) \le 2\frac{(1+k)^2}{1+k^2} \int_\T |f^*(ζ)|^2\,|dζ| =\frac{4K^2}{K^2+1} \int_\T |f^*(ζ)|^2\,|dζ|. \] The coefficient recovers the sharp analytic constant $2$ at $K=1$, is strictly smaller than the general harmonic constant $4$ for every finite $K$, and tends to $4$ as $K\to\infty$.
